item: TableCheck, Tabelog and OMAKASE accounts created with a working card
Site installed to Home Screen on both phones and logged in
Trip calendar subscribed on both phones; test one alert
Open the site once in airplane mode to confirm it works offline
Download a Google Maps offline area for central Tokyo
Data eSIM or pocket Wi-Fi sorted
Transit card in the phone wallet (confirm current Suica/PASMO options for your phone)
Entry and customs registration done (confirm current Japan arrival requirements for your passport)
Cash in yen — several kissaten and Kappabashi shops are cash-only
Physical passport on you for tax-free purchases over ¥5,500 (photos not accepted)
Mori Art Museum on 27 Nov: one listing says it closes at 17:00 that day, the event listing says 22:00
Hasedera's 2026 night illumination dates, on the temple's own site
teamLab's closed days for late November
International Driving Permit, issued in Hong Kong before flying. Confirm with the rental company that it covers a Hong Kong licence
Rental car for Fri 4 – Sun 6 Dec booked
MOA Museum of Art tickets for Sat 5 Dec, booked online. It closes on Thursdays and changeover days
Sun 6 Dec: car back by 13:30, airport by 16:30. Comfortable for Haneda; for Narita, return the car earlier. Start early on Saturday: the coast road fills by mid-morning
